description: This file defines custom models and extensions for invoice and invoice line handling in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including notification messages and invoice line behavior.

classes.name: notify_message
classes.description: Model for notification messages to be displayed at invoice bottom.

classes.name: account_invoice_line
classes.description: Extension of invoice line with custom fields and behaviors, including dynamic field properties and view logic.

classes.name: account_invoice
classes.description: Extension of invoice model with custom invoice line handling and copying behavior.

methods.name: move_line_get_item
methods.description: Returns move line info if line state is 'article'.

methods.name: fields_get
methods.description: Defines dynamic field properties based on line state.

methods.name: _onchange_invoice_line_view
methods.description: Handles view updates based on line type.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides creation to set default values based on 'state'.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides write to reset fields when 'state' changes.

methods.name: _fnct
methods.description: Computes display string based on line 'state'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Custom get method for one2many relation filtering 'article' state lines.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Overrides invoice copy to reset invoice lines.
